name: Akeno Himejima
source:
Akeno, like me, is a nephalem. But, if I remember correctly, [url=https://vndb.org/c144571]Lucifer[/url] said that our powers are completely different. She is [url=https://vndb.org/c152920]Rias[/url]'s servant, but in my opinion, she seems more like her best friend. She is interested in [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]me[/url] because we are similar and can understand each other on a deep level. It's like a spark that ignites something special in her, something I can't ignore.

[In game description]
